description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called SessionsSettings which displays session information in a notebook-like interface. It includes UI components like headers, lists, badges, and refresh controls, and handles asynchronous data loading via SessionLoader.

classes.name: SessionsSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that manages and displays session information with refresh capabilities.

classes.name: SessionKindBadge
classes.description: A small view that displays a badge for a session's kind.

classes.name: Badge
classes.description: A view that displays a small label badge with text.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a session snapshot and updates the view or shows an error.

methods.name: sessionRow
methods.description: Builds the UI for a single session row.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Creates a label with an icon and text.
